objective: Validate story-engine attraction before any prose generation.
human_question: Which premise, if any, makes you genuinely want to know what happens next?

acceptance.minimum: At least one premise receives an unforced actual-human desire-to-continue signal.

forbidden: fiction prose generation before actual-human premise selection
select a winner by model score
treat a premise selection as literary acceptance
next_action: Ask the actual human whether any of L/M/O creates genuine desire to continue because of these specific people. Reject-all or multi-select is valid. Do not generate prose.
